image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a golden hamster nestled in wood shavings. The hamster has golden-brown fur with a distinct dark stripe running down its back and over its head. It is facing the camera with visible black eyes, a pink nose, and rounded ears. Its front paws are tucked under or slightly visible near the chest. The background consists of blurred wood bedding and a partial view of a shelter structure above.
